scheduler.interpretation: Observed library segment lifecycle; not an independent proof verdict.

webrtcConnectionBudget.note: Library defaults, not overridden by this diagnostic. A single attempt can legitimately take up to roughly the sum of the ICE gathering and connection timeouts, plus however much of the offer wait it needs, before the library itself gives up.
